title: Essay Passage: Community
description: A longer essay passage about community; keep your rhythm through the commas and the repeated structure.

exercises.instruction: Match the calm, repeating rhythm of the examples all the way to the last sentence.
exercises.text: A community is a group of people who help and support one another. When someone is sick, the neighbors offer food and care. When it rains, they share umbrellas. A strong community makes life safer, warmer, and more joyful for every person who belongs to it.
